description.value: You feel perfectly at home where there's no gravity. Atraxids were early adopters of space flight among the Szandite Collective, and many atraxids took to it readily, thriving in a zero-g environment. You do not gain the clumsy and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Off-Guard] conditions due to being @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Untethered] in zero gravity, though you can still gain those conditions due to other effects.
